description: Is there a solar storm warning? Returns the latest official NOAA SWPC alerts, watches and warnings (geomagnetic storm watches, K-index warnings, flare and proton alerts) with type, headline, issue time and the verbatim message text. Useful for newsrooms and enthusiasts who need the official wording. The feed covers roughly the last few days only. (cost: 1 credit)

limit.description: integer, optional, how many alerts to return (1-50), default 10

since_hours.description: integer, optional, only alerts issued in the last N hours (1-720)

name: space_weather_alerts
